tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search live radio stations in the RoamDial directory by keyword, country, city, genre, or language. Returns verified stations with direct listenUrl and mapUrl.

tools.name: spin_globe
tools.description: Pick a random live radio station from the 3D globe (optionally constrained by country or genre) and sample its current ICY track title within a 2.5s budget.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Get the detailed profile of a station by ID or slug-id, including broadcast metadata, Wikipedia summary, RoamDial internal listener stats, and similar stations.

tools.name: get_now_playing
tools.description: Query real-time ICY stream metadata for a verified station in the RoamDial directory. Returns the track/show title, sampling timestamp (observedAt), and availability reason.
